title: INFLATION Reduction Act Means MONEY for HVAC!
summary: HVAC contractor's 2022 overview of the Inflation Reduction Act's home efficiency tax credits, including up to $2,000 for qualifying heat pumps.

assertions.quote: can take it credit up to two thousand dollars
make sure your contractor gets you the Ahri certificate

verdicts.note: Federal and most utility incentives require the matched indoor and outdoor units to meet efficiency tiers, usually shown by an AHRI certificate.
Edwards says most incentives require installed heat pumps to meet performance and efficiency standards, but says nothing about documentation of the equipment pairing.

IRS 25C page: heat pumps must meet the CEE highest efficiency tier (and from 2025 carry a qualified manufacturer QMID on the return), but the page does not specifically require proof of the matched indoor/outdoor pairing.

assertions.quote: homeowners can also get a credit up to 150 dollars for a qualified home energy audit

verdicts.note: The 25C credit included 30% up to $150 for a home energy audit through 2025.
IRS 25C page: a home energy audit of the main home may qualify for a credit of up to $150 if it meets the written-report and qualified-auditor requirements.
